convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom with unknown 'Candles_Smoothed' indicator and two external .mqh includes (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) requiring manual Python reimplementation of smoothed candle logic and trade management functions.

derived_values.name: Smoothed_High
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(InpInd_Handle, buffer_index=1, bar, 1) - smoothed candle high from Candles_Smoothed indicator buffer 1

derived_values.name: Smoothed_Low
derived_values.formula: CopyBuffer(InpInd_Handle, buffer_index=2, bar, 1) - smoothed candle low from Candles_Smoothed indicator buffer 2

other_exits: Long position closed when Close < Smoothed_Low - dLevel (if BuyPosClose=true)
Short position closed when Close > Smoothed_High + dLevel (if SellPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM<0: fixed lot size=abs(MM); MM>0: deposit fraction percentage

custom_logic_notes: The entry logic scans from SignalBar outward through historical bars to find the FIRST bar where Close breaks above Smoothed_High+dLevel or below Smoothed_Low-dLevel. Only if the break occurs AT SignalBar does it generate an open signal; otherwise it only generates a close signal. The Candles_Smoothed custom indicator applies user-selectable smoothing (from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh: SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA/JJMA/JurX/ParMA/T3/VIDYA/AMA) to candle OHLC data, producing smoothed high/low channels in buffers 1 and 2. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with built-in position management and global variable cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement Candles_Smoothed indicator: apply one of 10 smoothing algorithms (LWMA default) to OHLC to produce smoothed High/Low channels. The break-out logic compares bar close against smoothed channel +/- Level*point. Entry only on SignalBar break; exit signals from any bar break. The CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides 10 smoothing methods - need to port at least the default LWMA and any user-selected method. Trade position management from TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles buy/sell open/close with permission gates - straightforward to replicate. The scanning loop from SignalBar outward is unusual: it finds the first breakout bar and only generates entry if that breakout is at SignalBar.
